channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Rainfall Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description: As of today, there is no Heavy Rainfall Warning Issued.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:56 AM 01 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(CebuCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(DanaoCity, Compostela, Liloan, Consolacion and MandaueCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:14 AM 01 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Bongabong, Roxas, SanTeodoro, PuertoGalera, Baco, CityOfCalapan), #OccidentalMindoro(Paluan, AbraDeIlog, Mamburao, SantaCruz), #Palawan(Culion, Dumaran, Taytay, PuertoPrincesaCity, Balabac), #Cebu(Cordova), #NegrosOriental(Valencia, DumagueteCity), #EasternSamar(SanPolicarpo, Arteche, Jipapad, Oras and Dolores) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Siquijor, #NegrosOriental(Zamboanguita, Dauin, Bacong, CityOfGuihulngan) and #Cebu(LapuLapuCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 31 October 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #NegrosOccidental, #NegrosOriental, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
